blocks.heading: How AI Is Changing Both Fields

items.text: A common mistake in this comparison is assuming AI threatens only accounting ("software can do the books now") while finance stays safe because it looks more "strategic." That is incomplete.

In accounting, AI already automates data entry, bank reconciliation, and invoice matching, some CA firms report up to an 80% reduction in manual data-entry time and a 30% increase in client capacity within months of adopting AI tools.
In both fields, AI is shrinking the "easy entry task" layer and growing demand for the person who can frame the problem correctly, direct the AI tool, and own the final judgment call.
A CA or CMA qualification travels with you for life, is respected across every industry, and is much harder for an untrained newcomer to casually claim.
A balance sheet that ties out, a return that is filed correctly and on time, an audit finding that is fully explained, these are clean, closed, verifiable wins.
Articleship pay is low by design, it is a training period, not a real salary.

visuals.heading: Learning It Cheaply

figures.label: Budget Warning Threshold
figures.source: Our strongest suggestion: keep a course or degree fee near a tenth of the family's total education budget, and treat spending above roughly a fifth as a serious caution. An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 8 lakh budget, a tenth is Rs 80,000, and the rest can fund exam fees, a laptop, one skill course and a reserve. A high-income skill portfolio built beside the credential is the base of an earlier path to financial freedom.

blocks.heading: Questions Before You Commit to Either Path

figures.label: Qualification Time Window
figures.source: Can your family runway absorb 2-3 years of low or moderate pay while you build proof? CA articleship pays a stipend of roughly Rs 2,000-6,000 a month depending on city tier and year, for two full years, before the qualification even starts paying real money. Finance analyst roles pay a working salary from day one, but that salary is often lower at the very entry point than a fresher realizes from salary-screenshot hype.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: MD-level comp in investment banking is real but sits at the very top of a steep, narrow pyramid most analysts never reach. Most finance-track fresher pay (Rs 3-6 LPA for a plain financial analyst role) is closer to a CA fresher's Big 4 offer than salary-screenshot content suggests.
